extraction.input_text: On the issue of whether Ann and Austin had a discussion, Ann's statement to Austin, "I will sell my car to you for a cost."

claim.text: Is the statement described in this narrative hearsay under FRE 801(c)?

arguments.text: Ann's statement to Austin was made outside of the current proceeding, satisfying the out-of-court requirement for hearsay analysis.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) defines hearsay as an out-of-court statement.

arguments.text: The statement is explicitly offered 'on the issue of whether Ann and Austin had a discussion,' indicating it is not offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) excludes statements not offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted.
arguments.evidence_span: On the issue of whether Ann and Austin had a discussion

arguments.text: Offering the statement to prove that a discussion occurred constitutes a non-hearsay purpose (verbal act/circumstantial evidence of conversation), which defeats the hearsay classification under FRE 801(c).
arguments.legal_rule: Statements offered for non-truth purposes, such as to show a conversation occurred or effect on the listener, are not hearsay.
arguments.evidence_span: On the issue of whether Ann and Austin had a discussion
